`dispose.js` is a valid shared utility (idempotent deep-dispose) kept for the collection's shared layer — it's not imported, so it adds nothing to the bundle; I left it rather than churn. Everything else is wired and exercised.

## Done — Space Invaders // Neon Corridor builds and plays clean

**Verified end-to-end in a real browser (zero console errors across every run):**
- Menu → **Enter/Space starts** game
- Fire + move kills aliens, score/combo climb (`Score 160 ×3`), HUD live
- Pause (**P**) shows overlay; resume works
- Player death → respawn with invulnerability blink (confirmed: multiple hits before `INVADED`)
- **Game over** screen (`INVADED · NEW HI-SCORE 190`) → restart works
- Scene renders real content — alien formation, cyan neon, white-hot bloom highlights; menu frame 67% bright
- `npm run build` passes (550 kB JS / 142 kB gzip)

**Bugs found and fixed this session:**
| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `AlienFormation.js:33` | passed string names to `buildAlienFrames(idx)` → crash on boot | pass type indices `0/1/2` |
| `CameraShake.js` | called nonexistent `_clearOffset()` every frame after any hit → **frozen game** | removed the calls; offset now cleared inline + FOV restored |
| `Game.js:435` | `consumeShot(cooldown)` missing required out-param → crash on first shot | pass `this._muzzle` scratch |
| `Game.js` respawn | `deathTimer` never decremented → ship never respawned | decrement in the dead branch of `_updatePlaying` |
| `Game.js` game-over | read `deathTimer` (0) instead of `_overDelay` → instant screen, no explosion beat | use `_overDelay` |
| `Game.js:772` | **nobody called `hitstop.update()`** → timescale stuck at 0.12 after first hit-stop | call it in `_realtimeUpdate` |
| `BulletSystem`/`Game` | alien-bullet trails leaked on off-screen cull (pool exhausted) | wire `onBulletReleased` → release trail |
| `InputController.js` | sub-frame key taps (Playwright `press`, fast human taps) dropped — edge detection sampled held-state only; also a `Set`/Array `.some()` type bug I introduced mid-fix | record keys-pressed-since-poll in an array, raise edges from it |

**Constraint compliance:** vanilla JS + ES modules + Vite, Three.js only, no external assets (all geometry/textures/audio procedural), hand-written swept segment–circle collision, `MeshStandardMaterial` exclusively, glassmorphism DOM UI, keyboard + Gamepad, object pooling everywhere, 500-particle hard cap, explicit `.dispose()` registry in reverse order, `EffectComposer` + `UnrealBloomPass`, and all six VFX systems (particles, camera shake, hit-stop, motion trails, shockwave rings, floating score text).

27 source files, ~3600 lines. Run with `npm run dev`.
